updates.title: Spike: audit repo scoping, context derivation, and snapshot boundaries (search/index)
updates.description: Audit repo scope/identity derivation + propagation across index/search, and identify mixed-state + nondeterminism risks during incremental ingest.
acceptanceCriteria: Document repo identity inputs/outputs and where they are persisted
Identify mixed-state read paths and propose a per-request snapshot rule
Identify nondeterminism sources and propose stable ordering/tolerance rules

updates.title: Merged into bck-02-us-06-t16 (repo scoping + context derivation audit)
updates.description: Merged into `bck-02-us-06-t16`.
acceptanceCriteria: Task is cancelled; work tracked in `bck-02-us-06-t16`.

updates.title: Implement repo normalization + fingerprint resolution and propagate repo/index identity
updates.description: Implement deterministic repo normalization + `repoFingerprint`, and propagate repo/index identity (`indexRevision`) through index/search for keying + snapshotting.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo normalization is deterministic for equivalent paths
`repoFingerprint` is derived and propagated to index/search
An `indexRevision` (or generation id) is available for snapshotting/cache keying

updates.title: Enforce repo context presence/derivation at all request entrypoints
updates.description: Require or deterministically derive repo context at every index/search entrypoint; fail closed on missing/ambiguous scope.
acceptanceCriteria: All index/search entrypoints validate repo context
Missing/ambiguous repo context fails closed with canonical error
Downstream context includes normalized path + `repoFingerprint`

updates.title: Block cross-repo access by enforcing repo-scoped state roots and guards
updates.description: Derive all state roots from `repoFingerprint` and guard artifact open/read/write so cross-repo reuse is impossible.
acceptanceCriteria: State roots are keyed by `repoFingerprint` (not raw path)
Artifact identity mismatches fail closed
Failures do not leak cross-repo identifiers/content

updates.title: Fail-closed repo isolation gate in context assembly (filter + explicit errors)
updates.description: Centralize repo isolation checks in context assembly so requests either run fully repo-scoped or error explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Context assembly produces one validated repo scope
Any scope mismatch fails closed before downstream work
Error signaling is consistent across entrypoints

updates.title: Tag and enforce repo scope for ingested artifacts (docs/web-derived)
updates.description: Tag ingested artifacts with `repoFingerprint` (and where needed `indexRevision`) and enforce scope on reads/queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Artifacts are stored repo-scoped with repo identity metadata
Reads/queries enforce matching `repoFingerprint`
Stale artifacts are not reused across revisions unless policy allows

updates.title: Refactor shared caches into explicit repo+revision keyed interfaces
updates.description: Make caches explicitly keyed by `repoFingerprint` and (where applicable) `indexRevision`; add deterministic invalidation on incremental ingest.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache keys include `repoFingerprint`
Index-dependent caches are revision/snapshot keyed
Incremental ingest deterministically invalidates affected cache entries

updates.title: Implement safe web cache keying/partitioning for Tier 2 usage
updates.description: Partition Tier 2 web cache by `repoFingerprint`; ensure relevance-affecting entries are revision-keyed or invalidated per policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Web cache keys include `repoFingerprint`
Cross-repo cache reads are impossible
Relevance-affecting entries respect `indexRevision` (keyed or invalidated)

updates.title: Partition memory store by repo (read/write/query enforcement)
updates.description: Partition memory by `repoFingerprint` and enforce scope on reads/queries so memory cannot leak or destabilize relevance across repos.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory records are stored with `repoFingerprint`
Reads/queries enforce matching repo scope
Ranking-related memory features are deterministic for fixed inputs

updates.title: Enforce repo-scoped Tier 1 search with per-request index snapshot + deterministic ranking
updates.description: Guarantee stable ordering/scores for unchanged content and single-snapshot behavior per search request, including consistent `score`/`topScore` semantics under reranking.
acceptanceCriteria: Each search executes against one `indexRevision` (no mixed-state hits)
Unchanged repo + same query yields stable ordering; scores stable within documented tolerance
`score`/`topScore` semantics remain consistent for gating (rerank on/off)

updates.title: Spike: audit existing session + persistence surfaces
updates.description: Inventory current session/persistence identifiers and propose a repo-scoped, client-safe tracing surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory identifiers and where they are emitted
Identify cross-repo risk points
Recommend minimal safe external trace/session fields

updates.title: Stable session id lifecycle: create/resume/validate per repo
updates.description: Make session ids repo-scoped (validated with `repoFingerprint`) so session reuse cannot cross repos and traces can correlate behavior over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Session ids are created/validated with `repoFingerprint`
Cross-repo session resume fails closed
Session lifecycle is documented (create/resume/expire)

updates.title: Expose session id + tracing indicators (traceId, indexRevision) via client-facing surfaces
updates.description: Expose client-safe `traceId`, session id, and the `indexRevision` used for the request so clients can assert single-snapshot behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Search responses include client-safe `traceId` + session id
Search responses include `indexRevision`/snapshot id
No repo content or cross-repo identifiers are leaked via tracing fields

updates.title: Trace persistence error handling and policy-driven response flags
updates.description: Define behavior when trace persistence fails; keep response contract stable and add explicit persisted/not-persisted flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace persistence failures do not break response contract
Responses include explicit persistence outcome flag
Sensitive details are sanitized

updates.title: Spike: define error taxonomy and envelope contract for MCP tools (search/index)
updates.description: Define canonical error codes/envelope for search/index tools, including repo mismatch, stale revision, and ingest conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical codes/envelope fields are documented
Client-safe vs internal-safe error content is specified
Mixed-state/staleness scenarios have explicit semantics

updates.title: Implement shared error envelope builder and internal-safe error sanitization
updates.description: Implement shared error envelope builder with sanitization, mapping internal failures to bounded canonical codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared builder exists and is used by search/index tool paths
Sensitive fields are redacted from client-facing errors
Domain failures map deterministically to canonical codes

updates.title: Map repo/index/dependency/rate-limit domain failures to canonical codes
updates.description: Map domain failures to canonical codes, including distinct codes for stale revision vs ingest-in-progress.
acceptanceCriteria: All mapped failures yield canonical codes with stable meaning
Stale revision vs ingest conflict are distinct
Codes support client gating/retry without message parsing

updates.title: Standardize parameter validation across MCP tools (repo/search/index)
updates.description: Standardize validation for repo/search/index tools and return canonical validation errors via the shared envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Required params are validated consistently
Validation failures return canonical codes/envelopes
Validation does not leak repo identifiers/content

updates.title: Refactor MCP tool implementations to use shared validation and error mapping
updates.description: Refactor index/search MCP tools to use shared validation + canonical error mapping/envelopes.
acceptanceCriteria: Index/search tools use shared validation
Index/search tools use canonical error mapping/envelopes
Success/failure contracts remain stable across incremental updates

updates.title: Harden logs and errors against cross-repo identifiers/content leakage
updates.description: Harden logs/errors to avoid emitting raw paths/content/cross-repo identifiers; apply sanitization consistently in search/index flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Default logs/errors avoid raw content and full paths
Repo identity is represented with client-safe identifiers where needed
Sanitization is consistently applied across search/index

updates.title: Capture DAG nodes/edges for chat + tool events (incremental writes) with repo+revision metadata
updates.description: Capture DAG events with `repoFingerprint`, trace/session ids, and (where applicable) `indexRevision` to debug stability regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: DAG events are repo-scoped (`repoFingerprint`)
Events include correlation metadata (trace/session; revision when applicable)
DAG persistence failures follow documented policy and do not break search

updates.title: Repo isolation enforcement for DAG reads/writes
updates.description: Partition DAG storage by `repoFingerprint` and enforce repo scope on all reads/writes.
acceptanceCriteria: DAG reads/writes enforce repo scope
Cross-repo DAG access fails closed
DAG isolation aligns with index/search artifact isolation

updates.title: End-to-end isolation + relevance stability tests (multi-repo, incremental ingest, no mixed-state)
updates.description: E2E tests: stable ordering/scores for unchanged content; updated results after incremental ingest; no mixed-state hits; no cross-repo leaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated searches on unchanged repo return stable ordering and scores within documented tolerance
Incremental ingest updates are reflected without breaking response contract
Each search response is single-snapshot (one `indexRevision`) and repo-isolated
